purpose: hm sandbox vm compose up/down on KVM

the commands are still running after up returned, and app has its environment

detail.volumes: Error: service "a": `volumes:` is not supported yet by `hm sandbox vm compose` (v1 has no published ports, mounts, or service-to-service networking)

cases.name: a second up without down is refused and leaves the first project alone

detail.refusal: Error: project twice already has 2 sandbox(es); run `compose down` first
